note: Hand-kept parts of the architecture model (scripts/arch.py). 'virtual' declares the nodes that are not folders of the repo: databases and outside services. Copilot never invents these. Each one carries a 'source' (where the evidence for it is) and 'edges_from', which says how its connections are derived from the census (env: files that use one of these environment variables; tables: files that mention a database table; providers: files that use a key slot of a model provider in data/code/agents.json). Only code in the node's own group gets an edge to it (from_groups overrides that), so a table name that happens to appear in the M2C client's local store does not become a Postgres connection. 'pins' holds node positions you set in the System page's edit mode (?edit=1, Copy JSON); a node that is not pinned takes its position from content/topology.json, or is placed automatically.

virtual.label: Postgres
virtual.source: backend/migrations/*.sql define the schema (data/code/schema.json); the connection comes from DATABASE_URL and the SUPABASE_* variables (data/code/infra.json).

virtual.label: Upstash Redis
virtual.source: UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL and UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN in the environment (data/code/infra.json).

virtual.label: Upstash Vector
virtual.source: UPSTASH_VECTOR_REST_URL and UPSTASH_VECTOR_REST_TOKEN in the environment (data/code/infra.json).

virtual.label: LLM providers
virtual.source: The model providers with key pools in data/code/agents.json (providers).
